about_the_game:
Cook for your life!

We must perfectly prepare recipes using limbs harvested from zombies and ingredients ordered from the market. A wrong recipe or delayed dish will push the zombies' patience to the limit—and that could be the end of us.
Here, you’ll cook meals using ground-up limbs, meat, intestines, and other gruesome ingredients.
Each recipe has specific ingredients, a time limit, and unique tricks to get it right.
Even the slightest mistake can lead to tense moments in the kitchen.

Don’t show weakness!

You won’t escape aggressive zombies easily! Even when their bodies are torn apart, they’re not fully neutralized. They won’t stop attacking even if their arms are ripped off, and they’ll keep crawling after you even without legs. After taking them down, you must carefully transport their bodies to the cold storage.
But remember: one moment of carelessness, and you might end up one of them.

Grind and cook!

By tossing the limbs of slain zombies into the grinder, you’ll obtain the essential ingredients needed for cooking. This step is one of the most crucial parts of preparing your recipes.

Get ready!

The market is the heart of survival.
You’ll find everything here—from essential food ingredients and weapon parts to traps and infection medication.
While preparing your dishes using zombie meats and organs, you can also get the defensive supplies you need from here.
You can protect your home with traps and weapon systems and slow the spread of infection with medicines.
But beware: the richer the market, the more dangerous the nights.
Making the right choices not only ensures your orders are delivered—it ensures your survival.

Defend yourself!

Defending your house from the increasing nightly zombie attacks is a key to survival. Reinforcing doors can make it harder for zombies to break in and give you precious extra time with stronger layers of defense.
You can also lock the doors to prevent direct access, making your defense line more manageable. With various traps and shotgun-powered automated turrets placed inside your home, you can take down any zombies that breach the interior.
Setting up your defenses correctly greatly increases your chances of surviving the night.

Blood Moon!

When the Blood Moon rises, the hunger within the zombies becomes unstoppable.
They see nothing. They hear nothing.
They want only one thing: flesh.
Doors, traps, defenses... none of it matters anymore.
Tonight, an army of the truly ravenous dead will be at your doorstep.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages or may be inappropriate for viewing in the workplace. It includes violence (such as decapitation or dismemberment of zombie-like creatures, use of internal organs), depictions of blood, and mild profanity. The game contains violence, blood, and general mature content.
